# Facebook Ad Library Scraper

The Apify actor [`curious_coder/facebook-ads-library-scraper`](https://apify.com/curious_coder/facebook-ads-library-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **2.7.28**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Scrape ads from facebook ads library search results and facebook pages. Cost: $0.75 per 1K ads

## Pricing

Pay per event — ad $0.00075, Actor Start $0.00005 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/curious_coder/facebook-ads-library-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/curious-coder-facebook-ads-library-scraper@2.7.28#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      urls: []
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `urls` | array | yes |  | 🔗 URLs — List of facebook ads search URLs or Page URLs to scrape ads from |
| `scrapeAdDetails` | boolean |  |  | Scrape ad details — Enable this option to scrape ads details such as EU Reach info |
| `limitPerSource` | integer |  |  | #️⃣ Limit per input URL — Limit number of ads scraped per input URL. Leave it blank to scrape all available ads ℹ️ Actual number might exceed the given limit by upto 30 |
| `count` | integer |  |  | #️⃣ Total number of records required — Leave this field empty if you want to limit number of ads scraped |
| `scrapePageAds.period` | string |  | `""` | Date range — Search ads in given date range |
| `scrapePageAds.activeStatus` | string |  | `"all"` | Filter ads by active status |
| `scrapePageAds.sortBy` | string |  | `"impressions_desc"` | Sort ads by — Sort by impressions or date. Default: Impressions |
| `scrapePageAds.countryCode` | string |  | `"ALL"` | Filter ads by country — 2-letter ISO country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). This should be the official uppercase country code, such as `IN` for India, `US` for United States, etc. Use `ALL` for targeting all countries |
| `runTag` | string |  |  | Run tag — Add this value to 'runTag' column in the output |
| `proxy` | object |  |  | Custom proxy — You can use this option to customise the proxy country |

## Output

The actor publishes no dataset schema, so `items` are untyped objects.
